articles.title: Weather on the board today
articles.body:
A heavy high pressure system of caste animosity dominated the board all day, settling over the Discord doxxing thread with little movement.

The air was thick with claims of exhaustion from baiting and shitposting, creating a stagnant atmosphere that refused to clear.

By afternoon, a cooler front moved in from the Islamic takeover predictions, bringing sudden shifts in workplace discourse.

This was quickly followed by a localized downpour of Upper Caste self-deprecation, where Anon admitted to being diseased and shit while claiming civilization for the South. The precipitation was sharp but brief.

Late in the cycle, a fog of regional insults rolled in, mixing Andhra, Punjabi, and Marathi slurs into a dense, low-visibility haze.

Underneath the murk, a faint drizzle of maturity debates about age of consent persisted, though it was largely obscured by the heavier regional winds.

articles.title: Caste, Doxxing, and the Perils of Discord
articles.body:
Anon opened the evening by asking if regulars were tired of baiting.

The reply came in the form of a frantic exchange over personal identifiers, where one user pleaded for contact details via email while another refused to share caste information on the public channel. The refusal was rooted in a specific trauma.

An anon stated they had been doxxed once on another platform and regretted the mistake for four months. They insisted that their caste would not be disclosed here because baiters would exploit the gap between that disclosure and their anonymous identity.

The insistence was immediate and repeated. One user typed in all caps, asking the recipient to write an email instead, stressing that they were not a naive child and suspected the other party intended to harass them.

The antagonist in this dispute was identified by multiple respondents as a "Tamil abbo" with a history of ruining other users' lives. One poster listed names like motivanaon and crowanon as victims of this specific user's behavior.

The accusation was that the user was attempting to send a fake ID to lure the other anon into a private chat, a move the recipient rejected as a rabbit hole.

The recipient claimed they only wanted to contact the user regarding something important, but their hesitation was palpable. The tension escalated into a war of identities.

One user, using the username kaala_kaua, offered their email and Discord handle, asserting they had no links to their real identity on the platform. They asked the other party to contact them via a female intermediary, citing the rudeness of males.

The other user, still suspicious, asked for the caster's caste in a cryptic way, claiming it was related to a "Geeta thing." The first user responded with outrage, asking why their caste mattered and accusing the other of trying to marry them or expose them.

Intervening anons tried to calm the scene, advising the user to ignore the "subhuman" and keep living in their little world.

One poster mentioned missing a user named khichdi pyaara and another wondered if a specific skribble anon still posted on the board.

The thread dissolved into a mix of melancholy and technical troubleshooting, with one user complaining about a stomach ache after cooming five times, while the main dispute over email addresses and caste remained unresolved.

The board served as a mirror for the distrust that permeates the community, where sharing a username is an act of war and ignoring a rival is the only safe policy.

articles.title: Anon predicts Islamic takeover to replace workplace harassment
articles.body:
Anon posted a question suggesting that the subject matter would be considered Haram in an Islamic country. The response was immediate and hostile. One Anon asked if the location was Pakistan.

Another Anon replied with the phrase "Alhamdulillah." A third respondent declared that India would become an Islamic nation by the mid-22nd century, telling the board to enjoy their final days of freedom.

The thread quickly pivoted to disparaging specific individuals in the defense sector. Anon referred to women as five-foot gobar girls, questioning their purpose beyond collecting salaries and demanding no hard shifts.

Another poster noted the abundance of gobar in the defense force, linking this demographic to consistent military defeats. Further replies focused on personal details.

One Anon asked why a woman in the image had a child, speculating if she was divorced. Another used the phrase "aur ro pasmande" to describe the situation.

The tone remained focused on religious and racial slurs rather than the initial theological question. The thread concluded with a brief dismissal. One Anon stated that the situation would not actually be Haram.

Another simply called it an abbo thread, ending the exchange without resolution or further argument.

articles.title: UC Anon Denies Civilized Status
articles.body:
An anon on Indiachan /b/ declared that Gangu Ponga and Randput are civilized, while asserting that UK Anon constitutes a disease and shit. The poster used heavy Pidgin English to frame this self-deprecating racial hierarchy.

One respondent immediately challenged the premise, stating that the left-wing portion of the UK crowd consists of actual Rajpoots and Pongas. Another anon questioned the optics of a Bihari individual who had not committed theft, asking if that was a first in history.

The thread quickly shifted to calls for letting the mentioned groups die of hunger rather than engaging with them. A respondent accused the OP of hypocrisy, noting that the user was calling others names while using the same slur against himself.

The OP or another user responded with a direct command for the Tamil anon to eat shit and drink piss. The exchange highlighted a mutual agreement on dehumanization, with one poster labeling the subjects as AASI subhumans.

The discussion centered on the division between the "civilized" and the "diseased," with anons debating which specific subgroups fell into which category. One user asked why Gangu behaves this way, while another noted that the left had abandoned Bihar long ago.

The thread functioned as a closed loop of mutual insults where the only consensus was the rejection of the other.

articles.title: Regional Insults Recycle
articles.body:
Anon posted a transcript of regional insults, citing "ABBO BEST SAAR" and "BLAADY ABBO ARYAN BEST SAAR" as the primary exchanges. The text noted that the shouting continued between "MUTHLEEN" and "PSAMANDE HANDOO" before shifting to "UC" and "LC".

The poster declared the cycle was just the same material with different names. They asked how the participants were not bored of the repetition and questioned if they suffered from mental retardation along with their other illnesses.

No replies followed the post.

articles.title: Debate Over Age of Consent and Maturity
articles.body:
Anon asked for arguments against a lower age of consent that avoided legal technicalities, citing scientific claims that girls mature faster than boys.

He noted that many European nations and American states set the age at sixteen, arguing that being viewed as a monster for one less year was retarded. Responses ranged from defensive to violent.

One anon insisted fifteen-year-olds were not kids and had developed bodies, while another disagreed, calling children annoying and physically undeveloped.

A third respondent suggested the price of a finger and a jb, and a fourth threatened to fuck the poster’s daughter himself, calling him a cuck.
